events.text: CRITIQUE round 7 — PAINTER: (a) NO UNDO inside paint mode ('go-fuck-yourself ordeal') — strokes are unjournaled (mesh journal covers topo/transform only; ctrl+z in paint hits nothing or the wrong journal). (b) NO LAYER CONTROL — user wants to write over a base then 'fuck off everything behind it'; pipeline is restrictive. ARCHITECTURE NOTE (load-bearing): paint is RULED as a stroke PROGRAM (strokes+dither, NEVER pixels — project_paint_stored_as_stroke_program; old studio had paint layers, deferred at parity port: project_mesh_painter_layers). Both asks fall out of that architecture naturally: paint undo = pop last stroke + re-run the program (or checkpointed atlas replay for cost); layers = ordered stroke GROUPS with visibility/reorder/delete = re-run program minus the group; per-layer rows in the focus panel (region grid, row verbs eye/reorder/delete/merge-down). Do NOT invent a pixel-layer compositor — the stroke program IS the layer system. QUEUED behind the live state-model agent (owns ModelView/3d.zig/model_paint) — paint undo should ALSO integrate with the ctrl+z routing from 81309f7b0 (paint mode routes undo to the STROKE journal, not the mesh journal — count-annotated 'Undo (3 strokes)').
